title: INFO.DOC.-----AFL.DYM.------T.C.IMP.
description: Triple-crossing diagram on page 223 (T(IMP)M-21), paired with STF × PROJ-DY above. The triple-axis names what black-improvised-music's information-documentation structurally requires when both affinity-alignment-dynamism *and* temporal-continuity-implication are working partners: (PO)INFO-DOC (the political-output of information-documentation) crossed with AFL-DYM (affinity-alignment dynamism — the middle axis) crossed with T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication — the partner-axis). INFO-DOC sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow and the (po) prefix marking it as the political-output of the form's documentation. AFL-DYM (the middle axis) sits at upper-right. T-C-IMP sits at center-right as partner-axis. TH-CONT (thrust continuance) sits centrally as the bridging hub. AFL-DY-INT (the internal of affinity-alignment dynamics, written 'afl.dy.int.') anchors the bottom-left as the bridging-axis downward terminus. Structural argument: the triple-axis is the structural payload — the (PO) prefix on INFO-DOC marks that information-documentation has *already* been converted into political-output form by the controlling forces (matching the prior diagram's meta-reality-retardation). For the form to actually preserve its meta-reality potential, three axes must hold simultaneously: the subject-axis's political-output information-documentation, the middle-axis's affinity-alignment dynamism, and the partner-axis's temporal-continuity implication. TH-CONT at the central hub is what carries the form through all three axes. AFL-DY-INT at the bottom-left is the *internal* affinity-alignment dynamics — the form's actual interior affinity-working that exists prior to the political-output conversion. The structural argument: black-improvised-music's actual meta-reality potential (the prior page's prose target) requires the triple-axis configuration to hold open the connection from AFL-DY-INT through TH-CONT all the way to T-C-IMP — only with all three crossing-axes maintaining their working positions does the form's interior affinity-alignment reach temporal-continuity-implication; otherwise the controlling forces' political-output captures information-documentation alone and the form's meta-reality potential retards into the partner-axis's terminal time-implication.
